snippet.title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy Launch Trailer - Future Games Show at gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2713000/Resonance_A_Plague_Tale_Legacy/
Asobo Studio shared a gameplay-heavy launch trailer for the latest action-adventure in the Plague Tale series — Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy. It's out tomorrow, August 27, for PC & consoles.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
